The Objective section entirely omits all vital signs. In the Plan section, crucial patient education about the potential for malignancy of actinic keratosis if left untreated is absent. All additions were supported by the transcript and did not negatively impact the grade. These omissions collectively make the note noticeably incomplete, requiring careful review.
